text:
ashley.security: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC change to the webhook service account, our DAST webhook alerts spiked and a few SAST findings popped for generated client code. filing this as a quick sync so we don't lose context. :warning:
omar.eng: saw it too. DAST webhooks getting 401s from the scanner callback endpoint and retries flooding the pipeline. logs show header missing.
noah-oncall: I restarted the callback job to stop the retry storm, but we need a root fix. what changed in the RBAC change?
maria.platform: We added a restrictive binding on the webhook-sa to remove broad token:list access — intended to reduce blast radius for third-party connectors. That might have broken the scanner's token exchange.
omar.eng: exact error in the callback logs: ``503 | downstream auth failure: missing header X-Scanner-Signature`` — scanner didn't get the signed callback URL because the token minting failed. stack trace attached to incident ticket.
ashley.security: also saw SAST noise: our codegen template for the scanner client includes an ENV fallback that prints a KMS-encrypted value into a temp file during local dev. SAST flagged "hardcoded secret" in autogenerated file. it's a false positive but we can't leave it unsuppressed.
devx: can you paste the small snippet? maybe we can tweak the generator to use KMS decrypt at runtime instead of writing files.
ashley.security: snippet: ``if (!process.env.SCAN_KEY) fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/scan_key', 'dev-key-placeholder');`` — this placeholder trips detectors.
maria.platform: agree we should change generator. we should also add a small suppress rule for generated/ directory with a header comment that SAST knows to skip. but we must not suppress real failures.
omar.eng: proposed immediate mitigation: 1) rebind webhook-sa to restore the token minting permission temporarily, 2) patch generator to remove file write and use KMS client to decrypt into memory, 3) add a targeted SAST rule exception for files matching `^generated/scan-client` with a TODO and vault link.
noah-oncall: I can put the temporary RBAC revert in place for 30m while you patch. will annotate in audit log.
sre-bot: deploy started: patch/webhook-token-rebind -> staging (ci-1234).
audit-bot: NOTE: RBAC change by noah-oncall at 5532109920. Change request: revert-window=30m, reason="unblock scanner callbacks".
ashley.security: after revert, DAST callbacks stopped failing, retry backlog drained. Recording action items: (A) devx/maria to update generator and create PR with KMS-in-memory change, (B) omar to add SAST meta header and narrow suppression, (C) noah to document the temporary RBAC revert in the RBAC playbook and set a follow-up to harden token minting flow.
devx: I'll open the PR now: draft title "generator: decrypt scan key with KMS client, avoid writing to disk". cc @omar.eng for SAST header format.
omar.eng: SAST header format we use: ``// SAST: generated-file ignore-if-has-kms-link: https://go/repo/kms-usage`` — I'll add our internal policy reference and link to the eval checklist.
maria.platform: long-term we should add a check in the RBAC change workflow: before yanking token:list-like perms from webhook SAs, run the SA through a callback simulator. I'll add a GH issue.
ashley.security: also updating the incident scribe: add classification "scan-integration-failure", note false positive suppression justification, link PR, link audit entry. I'll add the note to the incident ticket (INC-5532).
noah-oncall: for compliance: ensure audit retention records capture the temporary rebind and the approving owner. I already added the approver tag in the audit-bot entry.
sre-bot: deploy succeeded: patch/webhook-token-rebind -> staging (ci-1234) — monitor for 5m.
devx: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/421 — includes unit test and a small integration test using the staging scanner simulator.
omar.eng: after PR merges, I'll update the SAST suppressions as a quick commit to `infra/.sast-ignore` with explanation. we'll run a full nightly scan to verify nothing leaks.
ashley.security: great. last items: ensure KMS keys used for scan client are rotated per schedule and that decryption never writes plaintext to disk in any environment. I'll create a checklist item in the secure-sdlc board. :memo:
noah-oncall: closing loop — incident scribe updated, RBAC revert rolled back at 5532110100 after patch deployed. will follow up in weekly RBAC review.
ashley.security: thanks all. moving to post-incident review doc to capture prevention and automation ideas. :+1:
